description: This file implements the backend for persistent storage of NEL policies and reporting endpoints/groups in SQLite, including schema creation, migration, and batch operation handling.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore::Backend
classes.description: Backend class managing SQLite database operations for NEL policies and reporting endpoints/groups, including schema creation, migration, batching, and commit logic.

classes.name: PendingOperation
classes.description: Template class representing a pending database operation (add, update, delete) for a specific data type.

classes.name: NelPolicyInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serializable information about a NEL policy for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serializable information about a reporting endpoint for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serializable information about a reporting endpoint group for database storage.

methods.name: CreatePendingOperation
methods.description: Static method to create a pending operation for a NEL policy, converting the policy into a database-ready form.

methods.name: CreatePendingOperation
methods.description: Static method to create a pending operation for a ReportingEndpoint, converting it into a database-ready form.

methods.name: CreatePendingOperation
methods.description: Static method to create a pending operation for a ReportingEndpointGroup, converting it into a database-ready form.
